# SoundDeck

> A free, open-source desktop app for Windows 10 and 11 that replaces the
> built-in sound scheme editor. Browse sound packs, preview every system event,
> and apply a whole scheme in one click — with an automatic backup of the
> previous scheme before any change.

SoundDeck is built with Tauri 2, React 19 and Rust. It runs without
administrator privileges, never modifies Windows system files, and writes only
to the current user's registry hive (HKCU\AppEvents\Schemes\Apps) — the same
location the official Control Panel applet uses. Every apply is reversible.

## Packs

Thirty packs are available from the app's public catalog, all of them real
audio from the original schemes:

- Windows default schemes: 98, XP, Vista, 7, 8 and 10
- The thirteen Windows 7 bonus themes: Afternoon, Calligraphy, Characters,
  Cityscape, Delta, Festival, Garden, Heritage, Landscape, Quirky, Raga,
  Savanna and Sonata
- The Windows Vista themes: Glass, Pearl and Tinker
- Microsoft Plus! for Windows 95: Jungle, Musica, Robotz and Utopia
- Microsoft Plus! for Windows XP: Aquarium, daVinci, Nature and Space

Users can also build their own pack from their own .wav files. Custom packs are
stored locally and never uploaded.

## Features

- Preview any sound before applying it
- Apply a whole pack in one click, or edit individual events with the per-event
  editor
- Automatic backup before every change, restorable at any time from the app
- Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, German and French, following the
  system language by default
- Light and dark themes

The project is not affiliated with Microsoft. Windows is a Microsoft trademark.
The classic scheme audio comes from public fan archives and from archive.org
items preserving original Windows installations; it is not redistributed by
Microsoft.

- [Home](https://sounddeck.lucashdo.com/): what the app does, the pack catalog, safety model
- [Download](https://sounddeck.lucashdo.com/download): installers, requirements, install steps
- [Changelog](https://sounddeck.lucashdo.com/changelog): every published release
- [Privacy](https://sounddeck.lucashdo.com/privacy): no account, no telemetry, no data leaves the machine

## Install

- winget: `winget install LucasHenriqueDiniz.SoundDeck`
- Direct download: https://github.com/LucasHenriqueDiniz/sounddeck/releases/latest

Requires Windows 10 version 1809 or later, or Windows 11. No administrator
privileges and no extra runtime needed — the app uses the WebView2 already
present on the system.
